hero.title: Having trouble with the app?
hero.subtitle: Response time · contact · help
hero.speech: Email us with the screen you were on and what went wrong.

help.title: Places you can get help
help.lead: You can call the numbers below when you need help.
help.when1388: For anything on your mind, if you are a teen
help.when109: When you feel like letting go of life
help.when117: When something at school is hard
help.when119: When your body is in danger right now
help.when112: When someone is threatening you right now
help.foot: You can find this list here anytime. It is not shown based on what you write. The app does not report on your behalf or notify a guardian.

report.consent: I agree to processing this report
report.scope: Your message, account ID, app version, screen path and language go to the operator. Saved records, conversations and wiki content are not attached automatically.
report.retention: Reports are deleted hourly once they are 30 days old, or when you delete your account.
report.optional: You can use the app without agreeing. Your report will not be submitted.
report.offline: Check your internet connection and try again.
report.unconfirmed: We could not confirm receipt. Try again.
report.limited: Try again later. You can send 2 reports per minute and 10 in 24 hours.
